#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Run one bounded CUDA job at a time; record exact inputs and resource use.

CUDA reserves a large virtual address range, so RLIMIT_AS is inappropriate.
The executable caps device data at 2.3 GB and checks free device memory. This
runner additionally enforces a process-tree resident-memory and wall budget.
"""
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import argparse, hashlib, json, os, resource, signal, subprocess, time
import psutil

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
CASES={}
for size,nt in [(96,16),(144,24),(192,32)]:
    for variant in ['global','split']:
        CASES[f'cuda_{variant}{size}']=dict(nr=size,ntheta=nt,nphi=size,
            flux_variant='global_llf' if variant=='global' else 'split_llf')
CASES.update({
    'cuda_global96_half':dict(nr=96,ntheta=16,nphi=96,flux_variant='global_llf',cfl=.175),
    'cuda_split192_half':dict(nr=192,ntheta=32,nphi=192,flux_variant='split_llf',cfl=.175),
    'cuda_inductive96':dict(nr=96,ntheta=16,nphi=96,flux_variant='split_llf',
        boundary_map_csv=str(ROOT/'external_model/induction_audit/boundary_map_inductive.csv')),
    'cuda_inductive192':dict(nr=192,ntheta=32,nphi=192,flux_variant='split_llf',
        boundary_map_csv=str(ROOT/'external_model/induction_audit/boundary_map_inductive.csv')),
    'cuda_width45':dict(nr=192,ntheta=24,nphi=192,latmax_deg=45,flux_variant='split_llf'),
    'cuda_width75':dict(nr=192,ntheta=40,nphi=192,latmax_deg=75,flux_variant='split_llf'),
})

def lower_priority():
    os.nice(15)
    resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(2400,2405))

def terminate(proc):
    os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
    try:proc.wait(timeout=3)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGKILL);proc.wait()

def run(name,wall_limit,force):
    out=ROOT/'results'/name;out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    if (out/'statistics.json').exists() and not force:
        print(name,'already completed',flush=True);return
    meta=json.loads((ROOT/'inputs/metadata.json').read_text())
    cfg=dict(nr=96,ntheta=16,nphi=96,rmin_au=meta['r0_au'],rmax_au=2.3,
        latmax_deg=60,radial_grid='uniform',gamma=1.5,thermal_pressure_factor=2,
        cfl=.35,order=2,threads=2,start_day=9,end_day=34,
        output_start_day=99,snapshot_days=2,final_snapshot=1,
        boundary_map_csv=str(ROOT/'inputs/boundary_map.csv'),
        probes_csv=str(ROOT/'inputs/probes.csv'),source_surface_au=0,
        map_rotation_rad_day=meta['rotation_rad_day'],map_epoch_day=0,
        map_longitude_offset_rad=meta['longitude_offset_rad'],
        outer_magnetic_radial_scaling=1,output_dir=str(out))
    cfg.update(CASES[name]);path=out/'run.cfg'
    path.write_text(''.join(f'{k}={v}\n' for k,v in cfg.items()))
    if (out/'statistics.json').exists():(out/'statistics.json').unlink()
    executable=ROOT/'solver/cuda/mhd_cuda'
    tracked=[executable,ROOT/'solver/cuda/mhd_cuda.cu',ROOT/'solver/cuda/device_physics.cuh',
        ROOT/'solver/cuda/reference_host.hpp',Path(cfg['boundary_map_csv']),Path(cfg['probes_csv']),path]
    (out/'input_code_provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps({str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in tracked},indent=2)+'\n')
    progress=ROOT/'monitoring/progress.json';prior=json.loads(progress.read_text())
    prior.update(updated_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),phase=f'CUDA MHD refinement: {name}')
    progress.write_text(json.dumps(prior,indent=2)+'\n')
    env=dict(os.environ,OMP_NUM_THREADS='2',OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS='1',MKL_NUM_THREADS='1',CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS='1')
    command=['/usr/bin/time','-v','-o',str(out/'resource_usage.txt'),str(executable),'--config',str(path)]
    start=time.time();peak=0;reason=None
    print('RUN',name,cfg['nr'],cfg['ntheta'],cfg['nphi'],cfg['flux_variant'],flush=True)
    with (out/'run.log').open('w') as log:
        proc=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=ROOT,stdout=log,stderr=log,env=env,
            preexec_fn=lower_priority,start_new_session=True)
        while proc.poll() is None:
            try:
                parent=psutil.Process(proc.pid);processes=[parent]+parent.children(recursive=True)
                resident=sum(p.memory_info().rss for p in processes if p.is_running())
                peak=max(peak,resident)
                if resident>3*2**30:reason='process-tree RSS exceeded 3 GiB'
            except psutil.Error:pass
            if time.time()-start>wall_limit:reason='wall-time budget exceeded'
            if reason:terminate(proc);break
            try:proc.wait(timeout=.5)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:pass
    usage=dict(case=name,started_utc=datetime.fromtimestamp(start,timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        wall_seconds_including_inputs=time.time()-start,exit_code=proc.returncode,
        backend='CUDA float64',device_data_cap_MB=2300,device_budget_including_reserve_MB=2500,
        process_tree_RSS_cap_MiB=3072,sampled_peak_process_tree_RSS_MB=peak/1e6,
        virtual_memory_cap=None,CPU_time_cap_s=2400,wall_limit_s=wall_limit,
        threads=2,nice_increment=15,termination_reason=reason)
    (out/'runner_usage.json').write_text(json.dumps(usage,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(usage),flush=True)
    if reason or proc.returncode:raise RuntimeError(f'{name}: {reason or proc.returncode}; inspect run.log')
    print((out/'statistics.json').read_text(),flush=True)

def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('cases',nargs='+',choices=CASES)
    p.add_argument('--wall-limit',type=float,default=1200);p.add_argument('--force',action='store_true');args=p.parse_args()
    # A nonblocking lock prevents our own accidental simultaneous CUDA jobs.
    import fcntl
    with (ROOT/'monitoring/cuda_runner.lock').open('w') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        for name in args.cases:run(name,args.wall_limit,args.force)

if __name__=='__main__':main()
